attributes.name: Despair
attributes.description: Disadvantage on all rolls (dealing or healing any damage ends).

attributes.name: Knockback
attributes.description: Forcibly move a creature X spaces, ignoring Difficult Terrain. Other creatures or the environment may halt movement prematurely and deal damage (see @rule:[falling-and-forced-movement|Falling & Forced Movement]).

attributes.name: Dominated
attributes.description: Your rolls are disadvantaged. Dominator spends your first action on each of your turns: moving, making a weapon attack, or casting a cantrip. Damage ends.

attributes.name: Beguiled
attributes.description: Dazed. Cannot Defend or allow anyone to Interpose for you. Damage ends.
